transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I understand the locating fixture on Assembly Cell 2 cracked during the last shift, and there's an alternate fixture available in the tooling crib. Before we go any further, I need to hear from Quality and Tooling on the suitability and validation status of that alternate fixture. As a reminder, a temporary tooling change requires documented validation, an operator briefing, and defined controls before production can resume — and I'll need those recorded as commitments before I can authorize anything. Let's hear where things stand.
